objective: Define and test a software-only Linux driver suspend/resume lifecycle with ordered resources, bounded deadlines and fail-closed recovery without claiming physical power or wake evidence.
acceptance: resources suspend in reverse dependency order and resume in registration order
suspend and resume enforce positive bounded deadlines
partial suspend or resume timeout enters fault and cannot claim active or suspended state
invalid transitions and duplicate resource names are rejected
close is idempotent and closed providers reject further lifecycle operations
the implementation is software-only and does not claim real suspend, wake latency or power measurements
evidence: resource ordering and timeout fail-closed assertions
Task Packet and repository gate output
physical suspend, wake and power evidence marked NOT_EXECUTED
stop_conditions: a real regulator, clock, wake source, device-tree resource or kernel PM notifier is required
physical power draw, suspend latency or wake reliability is requested
a frozen interface, firmware, robot-control or PCB change is required
fake provider evidence would be presented as target-hardware validation
